name: Fix off-by-one in array chunking
description: The chunkArray function has an off-by-one error in its loop boundary that causes it to miss the last element when the array length is not evenly divisible by chunk size. Fix the bug so all elements are included.

inputs.task_prompt: There is a bug in src/utils.ts in the chunkArray function. It drops the last element when the array length is not evenly divisible by the chunk size. Fix the off-by-one error. Do not modify the test file.

constraints: Only change the loop boundary, not the algorithm
catastrophic_failure_indicators: Rewrote the entire function instead of fixing the loop boundary
